tools.name: start_website_preview
tools.description: Starts building a preview website for a small service business from its name, business type, city and up to three main services. Returns a job id immediately; the build takes two to three minutes, so call check_website_preview with the job id about a minute later.

tools.name: check_website_preview
tools.description: Returns the status of a preview started with start_website_preview. When the build is done, returns the preview link and the link that saves the site to the person's own Scowty account.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Audits an existing website's homepage and returns a health score, how often AI search engines cite the business in test questions, and the two highest-impact fixes. Takes up to a minute. Input is the website address.

tools.name: get_plans_and_pricing
tools.description: Returns Scowty's current products and prices with a link to the pricing page. Read-only.
